thread:
maya_sales: CarterSec flagged a few more encryption/KMS items for tomorrow's vendor review: FIPS level, attestation docs for CloudHSM/Dedicated HSM, ability to import externally generated keys, and whether Redwood supports automated rotation w/ customer policy. Can security confirm what we can hand them pre-call?

imelda_security: Short answers we can hand: FIPS 140-2/3 depends on provider: AWS CloudHSM and Azure Dedicated HSM provide FIPS attestations; our Private connectors can integrate with FIPS-validated on-prem HSMs (e.g., Thales) but customer must provide physical attestation certs. We can attach vendor attestation PDFs and our integration checklist.

carter_cust: Followup: for "import externally generated keys" - does that mean we can upload a key blob you never see (so no export)? We need that for compliance.

imelda_security: Yes. Two modes: 1) Import key material into customer-managed KMS in their cloud account (customer controls import and expiration; Redwood never has plaintext). 2) External key-wrap with customer-held KEK: client encrypts data key locally and sends ciphertext to Redwood. We'll document both flows and a minimal test.

andre_sre: For a reproducible test (single command) we can provide an Azure Key Vault flow and an OpenSSL verification for TLS. Example for import check (Azure):

`az keyvault key import --vault-name my-vault --name poc-key --pem-file ./customer_key.pem`
`# then use Azure SDK or curl to call our POC endpoint with the wrapped key reference`

andre_sre: And for AWS import-flow: generate key in your account, create a grant for our POC role, then run a single encrypt/decrypt call. We'll give step-by-step.

toni_platform: Add note: when keys live in customer's account (BYOK) our control plane receives only key references and never persists plaintext. We record IAM principal and operation in audit log. Rotation: we support policy-driven rotation; default recommendation is annual for imported keys (unless customer policy says otherwise). We can set automatic re-wrapping of data keys when CMK rotates.

sam_legal: Procurement wants a one-line carve: "No escrow of customer key material by Redwood; customer retains sole possession of key material when using BYOK/imported keys." Can security approve?

imelda_security: Yes, we can sign off on that for BYOK/imported keys. For Dedicated private deployments where Redwood operates HSM hardware on customer premises, we provide a custody model in SOW and can discuss escrow under explicit contract terms.

carter_cust: Can you show an actual audit event format we provide to customers? Need to map to our vendor review CSV.

imelda_security: Will include a redacted JSON event sample. Example (redacted):

`{ "eventTime": "2025-07-15T10:21:03Z", "eventName": "Encrypt", "principal": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPOCRole", "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh", "result": "Success" }`

imelda_security: Also note: we persist logs for 13 months by default; can extend per contract. Logs include principal, operation, keyId, request metadata (IP, region).

maya_sales: Procurement pricing line ? CarterCorp wants to know if BYOK/import adds cost for POC. Keep it vague but clear for SOW.

sam_legal: Keep commercial language: "BYOK/import support is provided as part of Private/Dedicated engagements; optional connector/integration fees may apply for on-prem HSM adapters. Exact fees to be quoted by commercial team."

andre_sre: Tiny TLS check we can ask them to run during call: `openssl s_client -connect redwood-poc-carter-01.redwood.ai:443 -tls1_3 -servername redwood-poc-carter-01.redwood.ai` then verify certificate issuer and protocol. We'll add that to the one-pager.

toni_platform: For attestation we can attach vendor-signed FIPS/Audit certs and a short mapping doc: which controls are enforced where (e.g., key non-export enforced by HSM, audit by cloud provider, rotation and rewrap by Redwood runtime).

carter_cust: Perfect. Can you also confirm default rotation cadence for Redwood-managed CMKs (not BYOK)? Our policy threshold is 90 days.

imelda_security: Default Redwood-managed CMK rotation is 90 days for high-security tenants; standard is 365. We can set per-customer via config and document in SOW.

maya_sales: Action items: @imelda_security produce attestation pack + redacted audit sample; @andre_sre produce Azure/AWS minimal import test steps and openssl TLS check; @toni_platform produce control-mapping one-pager. I'll consolidate into a single ZIP and send before tomorrow's review.

carter_cust: Thanks team. EOD delivery is great. We'll review the attestation pack in the call and run the import test live if time permits. :thumbsup:
